build.source: Wingetter.ps1 launcher plus the dot-sourced modules under src/ at the v6.1.0 tag
build.notes: Wingetter.exe is built from Wingetter.ps1 using PS2EXE on a Windows host with PowerShell 5.1 or 7+. The current Wingetter.exe predates the module split: it was produced from the monolithic v6.1.0 launcher. Rebuilding from the modular launcher requires either bundling the src/ modules into the EXE or relying on the launcher's raw-GitHub module-download path.

artifacts.description: PS2EXE-packaged Wingetter launcher built from v6.1.0.
Repository-level icon used by the launcher at runtime and the README header.
